from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, ast, json

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/worktrees/rollout-zombie-fix")
testfile=wt/"tests/test_rollout.py"

def run(args,check=True):
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True)
    print("$"," ".join(args))
    print(p.stdout)
    print(p.stderr)
    if check and p.returncode!=0:
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    return p

src=testfile.read_text()
tree=ast.parse(src)
classes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef)]
if not classes:
    raise SystemExit("no test class found")
# Prefer class that already references assess_upgrade.
chosen=None
for c in classes:
    segment=ast.get_source_segment(src,c) or ""
    if "assess_upgrade" in segment:
        chosen=c
        break
if chosen is None:
    chosen=classes[0]

lines=src.splitlines()
insert_at=chosen.end_lineno
block='''
    def test_zombie_daemon_descendant_does_not_block_upgrade(self):
        rows = [
            {"pid": 100, "ppid": 1, "state": "S", "command": "do-again daemon"},
            {"pid": 101, "ppid": 100, "state": "Z", "command": "(git)"},
        ]
        with patch.object(rollout, "service_status", return_value={
            "installed": True, "running": True, "pid": 100,
        }), patch.object(rollout, "_request_state", return_value={
            "pending_requests": [], "started_requests": [],
        }), patch.object(rollout, "_shared_browser_child_pids", return_value=set()):
            result = rollout.assess_upgrade(self.repo, process_rows=rows)
        self.assertFalse(any(b["kind"] == "executor_children" for b in result["blockers"]))

    def test_live_daemon_descendant_still_blocks_upgrade(self):
        rows = [
            {"pid": 100, "ppid": 1, "state": "S", "command": "do-again daemon"},
            {"pid": 101, "ppid": 100, "state": "S", "command": "git fetch origin operator-control"},
        ]
        with patch.object(rollout, "service_status", return_value={
            "installed": True, "running": True, "pid": 100,
        }), patch.object(rollout, "_request_state", return_value={
            "pending_requests": [], "started_requests": [],
        }), patch.object(rollout, "_shared_browser_child_pids", return_value=set()):
            result = rollout.assess_upgrade(self.repo, process_rows=rows)
        blockers = [b for b in result["blockers"] if b["kind"] == "executor_children"]
        self.assertEqual(len(blockers), 1)
        self.assertEqual(blockers[0]["processes"][0]["pid"], 101)
'''.strip("\n").splitlines()

# Avoid duplicate insertion.
if "test_zombie_daemon_descendant_does_not_block_upgrade" not in src:
    lines[insert_at:insert_at]=[""]+block+[""]
    testfile.write_text("\n".join(lines)+"\n")

# Syntax check first.
run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/service/rollout.py","tests/test_rollout.py"])
# Run focused file.
run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_rollout"])
# Run full test suite to catch regressions.
run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests"])

run(["git","status","--short"])
run(["git","diff","--check"])
run(["git","add","src/do_again/service/rollout.py","tests/test_rollout.py"])
run(["git","commit","-m","Ignore zombie daemon children during rollout preflight"])
run(["git","push","-u","origin","fix/rollout-ignore-zombie-children"])

print(json.dumps({
  "branch":"fix/rollout-ignore-zombie-children",
  "head":run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip(),
},indent=2))
print("ROLLOUT_ZOMBIE_CHILD_FIX_COMPLETION_OK")
